executive_brief: This project is a serverless, client-side Single-Page Application designed for managing a sales catalog with real-time search, filtering, and CRUD operations. Hosted entirely within modern web browsers, it relies on a frontend-only architecture using Vanilla JS and localStorage for portable data persistence. The system strictly separates concerns through ES6+ modular JavaScript, BEM-structured CSS, and semantic HTML5. Core orchestration is centralized in a main module that delegates event binding, DOM manipulation, and storage wrapping to dedicated sub-modules. Performance targets mandate sub-100ms UI updates and 60fps modal animations, ensuring a responsive experience across desktop and mobile platforms without external backend dependencies.

architectural_constraints: UI updates for filtering and sorting must execute in less than 100ms
Catalog scale is limited to a maximum of 1000 items
Strict separation of concerns: no inline styles or inline event handlers permitted
Offline-capable architecture with zero external backend dependencies
Manual browser testing required across Chrome, Firefox, and Safari
W3C HTML and CSS validation required
All application logic must be encapsulated within JS modules

maturity_assessment: The specification demonstrates a solid foundational architecture with a fully passed constitution check and well-defined module boundaries. However, the project requires REFINEMENT before execution can proceed safely. The structural analysis reveals a critical high-severity gap regarding Data Models and Schemas, meaning the core data structures for the sales items are currently undefined. Additionally, medium-severity gaps exist due to the absence of explicit internal API contracts or data flow diagrams between modules, alongside undocumented open questions such as image upload handling in a serverless context. A low-severity gap also notes the lack of security considerations for localStorage data integrity and XSS prevention in the admin interface. These missing structural components must be addressed to ensure robust implementation.
critical_dependencies: MOD-MAIN depends on MOD-STORAGE, MOD-CATALOG, and MOD-UI for orchestration and event binding
MOD-CATALOG depends on MOD-STORAGE for retrieving and persisting item data
MOD-UI relates to MOD-CATALOG for rendering filtered and sorted item lists
MILE-PERF performance gate relates directly to MOD-UI for sub-100ms updates and 60fps animations
ARCH-SPA depends on ARCH-LOCALSTORAGE for offline-capable browser-based persistence
Browser localStorage API availability is mandatory for data persistence
Modern Web Browser environment supporting ES6+ JS modules, Flexbox, and Grid is required
